title: Gat Tayaw & The Liliw Bird
description: Founded in 1571 by Gat Tayaw, traditional lore recounts that a bird alighted on a ceremonial bamboo pole and sang 'Liw, Liw, Liw'—inspiring the town's enduring name.

title: St. John the Baptist Parish
description: First established by the Franciscans in 1605, Liliw's baroque red-brick church stands on an elevated patio overlooking the town plaza and the foothills of Mt. Banahaw.

title: Tsinelas Capital of Laguna
description: Generations of Liliweño shoemakers along Gat Tayaw Street have crafted durable, stylish footwear, celebrated every April during the vibrant Gat Tayaw Tsinelas Festival.

title: Highland Cold Springs & Delicacies
description: Blessed with a cool upland climate and crystalline mountain streams, Liliw is famed for its natural cold spring resorts and traditional delicacies like uraro cookies and espasol.
